# Rocking Chair

GameCore theme sourced from a **real design object** in the Art Institute of Chicago.

## Work
- **Title:** Rocking Chair
- **Artist / Maker:** Made by Jacob And Josef Kohn Austria, Vienna
- **Date:** c. 1881
- **Style / Period:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** chair
- **Department:** Applied Arts of Europe
- **AIC artwork ID:** 33053
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/33053
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/2a491673-72e1-34a9-8e2a-b45a6e0da51f/full/400,/0/default.jpg
